metadata.case_name: KAN KIT YUK v. CHUNG KWOK CHUEN

plaintiff.occupation_after: clerk at the MacLehose Rehabilitation Centre processing applications to use the "Rehab-bus" (temporary employment started October 1996)

injuries.description: Third degree (deep) burns affecting approximately 25% of body surface
source: third degree severe deep burns to twenty five percent of her body area

injuries.description: Burns and keloidal scarring of the face
source: (i) her face,

injuries.description: Injury to left ear with shrinkage and deformity
source: (ii) her left ear,
The upper one-third of the left ear and the left ear lobe are shrunken and deformed.

injuries.description: Keloidal burn contracture involving lower lip, chin, neck and extending onto the chest causing limitation of neck extension
injuries.body_part: neck; lower lip; chin; upper chest
source: (iii) her neck,
There is a very ugly conspicuous keloidal burn contracture over the lower lip, chin, neck and extending onto the chest which prevents full extension of her neck.
injuries.icd_description: Other specified injuries to the neck

injuries.description: Burns and skin graft scars of breasts and front upper abdomen / chest
injuries.body_part: breasts; front of upper abdomen; chest
source: (iv) her breasts,
(v) the front of her upper abdomen, and
There are extensive conspicuous ugly partially keloidal burn scars, and skin graft scars over approximately one-third of the front of the chest.
There are extensive ugly skin graft and burn scars on the upper abdomen and beneath both breasts.
injuries.icd_description: Other specified injuries to the thorax

injuries.description: Burns and skin graft scars of right arm and hand with surgical scars and finger contractures
injuries.body_part: right shoulder; right forearm; right hand
source: (vi) both her arms and hands.

There is conspicuous ugly burn scar on the front of the right shoulder, over two-third of the surface of the forearm and the whole of the back of the hand and parts of the front of the hand. There are also conspicuous skin graft areas over the wrist, back of fingers, thumb and hand and front of part of the fingers. Surgical scars are also evident over the palm of the hand.
Burn scar contracture and deformity are evident in the fingers.
injuries.icd_description: Injuries to the wrist or hand

injuries.description: Burns and skin graft scars of left arm and hand with surgical scars and finger deformity
injuries.body_part: left upper arm; left forearm; left hand; wrist
source: There is extensive conspicuous ugly burn scar over one-third of the upper arm and most of the forearm. The whole of the hand and wrist area is covered by conspicuous ugly burn and skin graft scars and in addition there are conspicuous surgical scars in the palm. The fingers are mildly deformed by burn scars.
injuries.icd_description: Other specified injuries to the wrist or hand

injuries.description: Conspicuous keloidal surgical scar in left groin (22 x 3 cms)
source: There is a conspicuous ugly darkly pigmented keloidal surgical scar in the left groin over an area of 22 x 3 cms.
injuries.icd_description: Superficial injury of abdomen, lower back or pelvis

injuries.description: Skin graft donor site scars on thighs and lower legs (darkly pigmented and thickened in parts)
source: Over the circumference of the middle one-third of the thigh there are conspicuous skin graft donor area scars which in parts are darkly pigmented and thickened.
Over the front, inner and outer aspects of the lower leg there are conspicuous pigmented skin graft doner area scars.
Over the circumference of most of the thigh there are ugly conspicuous pigmented skin graft doner area scars which are darkly pigmented and thickened in parts.
injuries.icd_description: Other specified injuries to the hip or thigh

source: release of scar contracture of the left hand
The whole of the hand and wrist area is covered by conspicuous ugly burn and skin graft scars ... The fingers are mildly deformed by burn scars.
injuries.icd_description: Other specified injuries to the wrist or hand

manifestations.description: Residual stratum of sadness which is likely to be permanent or at best intermittent
Self-conscious about her scars, particularly those that were visible, such as the face and hands; apprehension of re-integration into society
Left corner of the mouth pulled down by thickened heaped up keloidal scar
Left lower eyelid is pulled down when she opens her mouth widely or attempts to extend her neck
Prevents full extension of her neck
When she attempts to extend her neck both breasts are displaced upwards by bands on scar contracture
Loss of strength and dexterity of her hands as stated in the occupational therapist report
Could no longer engage in sports, swimming and outdoor activities which she enjoyed before the accident
It is unlikely that she will ever marry and experience the joys of marriage and having children (judge's finding)

treatments_received: carpal tunnel release for both hands
release of scar contracture of the left hand
release of scar contracture over the neck with skin grafting
treatments_future: five to six more operations in the future
ongoing pressure garment therapy (body garment during day and mask at night)

losses.description: Extensive very ugly conspicuous keloidal burn scars involving most of the left side of the face, front and sides of the neck, breasts, arms, hands and donor sites

losses.category: Loss of ability to engage in sports and hobbies
losses.description: She was an extremely active young person who liked to engage in sports, swimming and outdoor activities. She could no longer engage in those activities.
It is unlikely that she will ever marry (judge's finding).

losses.category: Loss of ability to participate in parenthood or grandparenthood
losses.description: Judge's finding that it is unlikely she will experience the joys of having children.

Her work has been of a temporary nature; types of jobs she is capable of performing are limited and it will be difficult for her to maintain long term work and she will suffer periods of unemployment and handicaps in the labour market.

losses.category: Loss of confidence in going out in the public
losses.description: Observed to be self-conscious about her visible scars and showed apprehension of re-integration into society.
Judge observed she can no longer lead a normal life.
